descriptor.leniency_stated_not_hidden: 'absent' (no OS descriptor at all) is recorded and allowed: it is the in-memory fixture. subprocess.PIPE always has a descriptor, so production cannot reach it. Five pinned tests in tests_lab_design.py feed the drain io.BytesIO; refusing 'absent' would require editing a file under the harness pin.
descriptor.now: make_nonblocking() returns nonblocking / blocking / absent. 'blocking' (a descriptor that could not be made non-blocking) refuses TWICE: in main() before the drain is built and before any dispatch, and inside drain_to_artifact, which then reads nothing and creates no artifact. The receipt records capture_descriptor.
descriptor.was: the drain fell back to a BLOCKING read when os.set_blocking failed -- the one read the deadline cannot interrupt, so the fallback quietly reinstated the defect the non-blocking repair removed
